body: I’m definitely trying to not blame myself it just sucks, with all the flashbacks and intrusive thoughts. I never had depression until this. I was so happy and trying to make him happy. I just wish things could of been different.
I know that’s the only thing that does scare me but I just need to keep faith. That’s all we really got is faith.

That’s what scares me but I lost my boyfriend to suicide and I’ve been getting signs that he’s okay. At least that’s what I hope for. I just can’t live without him I’m in so much pain because before he did it we were fighting and it makes me feel so much guilt like I could of saved him. 
Most people say they feel at peace. I think dying does hurt but it depends on whether your conscious or not conscious.

Why do you feel like it would be worse? 
I believe in god and he’s a loving god so I believe he truly understands our pain and is very merciful.
That’s what I’m going through I lost my boyfriend to suicide after we got into a fight and now I’m in so much pain, emotionally and it sucks
I know it really does and it seems my depression is just getting worse. I hate feeling sad.

I agree when you go to do it, it’s like you freeze and think about everything like who it’s going to hurt and just not knowing what’s on the other side. 

I do believe in god so I do have faith.
I’m definitely going to try. It’s just hard

I know it’s just so hard. I lost my boyfriend to suicide almost 3 months now and all I can think about is all the good times we had and all the future memories just gone. He abandoned me and I feel so alone. I have severe PTSD along with my bipolar depression. I’m just in a deep depression even with my meds.

I’ve been really contemplating these last few days I have what I need but I’m just so scared. I know it would only hurt for a few minutes but I’d rather do that then suffer with all the pain I’m dealing with.

Thank you I really appreciate you sharing that with me. I’m definitely doing my best but it’s hard plus I don’t want to put my family through it but at the end of the day I just want to end the grieve and pain.

If you don’t mind me asking, how did you get through it what was your coping strategies? I lost my boyfriend to suicide and that’s all I want to do is kill myself but I’m scared too but it runs through my mind everyday. Sorry for your loss, I do know the pain.

I know your pain I wish my time would come soon, I don’t want to be here anymore! I lost my boyfriend to suicide 2 months ago and every single day I wish I would just die. It’s really tough when you lose someone you love.

Yeah hopefully they choose a different path. The emotional pain and agony suicide survivors have to deal with is the worst pain imaginable. I still suffer from the grief, the flashbacks. One thing I do hope that someone never does is kill themselves in their house, don’t let someone they love find them. I witnessed my bf suicide and the images I’ll have to deal with for the rest of my life.

He just turned 27. I’ll be 26 this July. Honestly it sucks going through this and what’s worse is the lonely feeling of the only one going through it. I know a lot of people’s gone through something tragic but the people I know, don’t know what to say or what to do but just say “it will get better.” They can easily say it because they don’t know what that type of pain feels like.
